name: Slayer Warhound
body:
A warhound is a humanoid beast, a trained stalker who hunts and kills his master’s enemies with the aid of an animal companion.

Animal Companion

The warhound gains an animal companion at 1st level, treating his slayer level as his druid level. His animal companion does not gain the share spells ability. Instead, whenever the warhound gains a studied target bonus, his animal companion gains the same bonus against the same target.

This ability delays studied target until 2nd level, and replaces the stalker and slayer’s advance class features.

Studied Target

The slayer does not gain studied target at 1st level, instead gaining it at 2nd level. It then improves normally at 5th level and every 5 levels thereafter.

This ability replaces the talent gained at 2nd level.
